dedupe_keys.name: opsdn software defined network simulator extension

description: OPSDN extends OPNET Modeler to simulate software-defined networking with a controller inside the discrete-event run. The JOSS paper says this avoids real-time coupling to an external controller in large topology studies. The own README lists a Ryu-like controller API and a Windows, MSVC and OPNET 18.6.1 environment. GitHub classifies OPSDN code GPL-3.0, so that extension is free under its own licence. A modeller supplies a topology, traffic and controller logic. Outputs include simulated network events and performance measures. Geographic and temporal scope follow that configured network and run. Infrastructure researchers could use it to test digital-network control during high traffic or faults. A caveat is that results depend on the proprietary OPNET/Riverbed Modeler environment, whose separate licence and cost were not checked. Simulator compatibility and performance claims were not independently tested. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed. No software was installed or run.
